
```jsx
import { CxPlaceholder } from '@chassis-ui/react'
// or
import CxPlaceholder from '@chassis-ui/react/src/react/src/components/placeholder/CxPlaceholder'
```

| Property | Description | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| **animation** | Set animation type to better convey the perception of something being actively loaded. | `'glow'` \| `'wave'` \| `undefined` | - |
| **className** | A string of all className you want applied to the component. | `string` \| `undefined` | - |
| **component** | Component used for the root node. Either a string to use a HTML element or a component. | `string` \| `ComponentClass<any, any>` \| `FunctionComponent<any>` \| `undefined` | span |
| **context** | Sets the context context of the component to one of Bootstrap React's themed colors. | `'primary'` \| `'secondary'` \| `'success'` \| `'danger'` \| `'warning'` \| `'info'` \| `'dark'` \| `'light'` \| `string` | - |
| **lg** | The number of columns on large devices (<1200px). | `number` \| `undefined` | - |
| **md** | The number of columns on medium devices (<992px). | `number` \| `undefined` | - |
| **size** | Size the component extra small, small, or large. | `'small'` \| `'xsmall'` \| `'large'` \| `undefined` | - |
| **sm** | The number of columns on small devices (<768px). | `number` \| `undefined` | - |
| **xl** | The number of columns on X-Large devices (<1400px). | `number` \| `undefined` | - |
| **xs** | The number of columns on extra small devices (<576px). | `number` \| `undefined` | - |
| **xxl** | The number of columns on XX-Large devices (≥1400px). | `number` \| `undefined` | - |
